items.event_time_ist: Report published Oct 11, 2026, covering a ~5-week window
items.title: DOJ: 64 foreign nationals charged with illegal voting across 17 states in five-week crackdown
items.summary: Fox News Digital (Rep-leaning), from figures DOJ gave it: 64 foreign nationals charged with unlawful voting, fraudulent registration and election-related offenses in roughly five weeks across 17 states — Minnesota leads with 11 defendants, Pennsylvania 10, Texas 9. Total since Jan 2025: 104 people charged with voting-fraud offenses. A DOJ spokesperson framed weekly cases against the six-vote margin of the 2020 Iowa House race. No case has been established as changing an election outcome. (Wire only: Fox original + wire-copy republishers carry it; Breitbart a same-lean repeat.)

items.title: SC Senate: markets price Graham at 86c despite tightening polls — widest polls-vs-markets gap of the cycle
items.summary: Action Network's live tracker (independent): Graham is YES 86c on both Polymarket and Kalshi, Andrews YES 15-16c, both exchanges reading the same signal (SC's R lean, late money) — yet public polls show a 1-4 pt race (Rasmussen 49-45, Trafalgar ~+1, InsiderAdvantage 46-45). Same polls-vs-markets disconnect as Iowa (reported Oct 13). Market pricing, not a prediction.
